definitions: A strip or stripe of a different color or material.
The action of forming into a band or group.
The process of attaching a band to something, especially for identification or measurement.
A method of securing or strengthening with bands.
examples: The banding on the pottery was intricate.
Bird banding is crucial for migration studies.
The banding of the new recruits was completed.
The metal banding reinforced the crate.
